wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-: This page shows revisions that have been automatically flagged for review. If the revision is a false positive for the tag it matched, then use the buttons in the actions column to mark the revision as a false positive. If the revision is a true positive, then suppressing the text of the revision will mark it as handled. If the revision is a true positive but no more action is needed, then mark it as needing no further action to set it as handled.
